description: Source code for the SerializerManager class in Apache Spark, responsible for configuring serialization, compression, and encryption for Spark components, including serializer selection for shuffles.

classes.name: SerializerManager
classes.description: Manages serialization, compression, and encryption settings for Spark, including serializer selection and stream wrapping.

methods.name: setDefaultClassLoader
methods.description: Sets the default class loader for Kryo serializer.

methods.name: getSerializer
methods.description: Selects the appropriate serializer based on class tag and auto-pick flag.

methods.name: getSerializer
methods.description: Chooses serializer for shuffling key-value pairs based on class tags.

methods.name: wrapStream
methods.description: Wraps input/output streams with encryption and compression based on block ID.

methods.name: wrapForEncryption
methods.description: Wraps a stream with encryption if encryption key is provided.

methods.name: wrapForCompression
methods.description: Wraps a stream with compression if enabled for the block type.

methods.name: dataSerializeStream
methods.description: Serializes data into an output stream.

methods.name: dataSerializeWithExplicitClassTag
methods.description: Serializes data with explicit class tag into a ChunkedByteBuffer.

methods.name: dataDeserializeStream
methods.description: Deserializes an input stream into an iterator of values.

methods.name: blockSerializationStream
methods.description: Creates a SerializationStream for a block.
